div.div:
أَهْلِىٌّ A domestic beast [or bird]; a beast [or bird] that keeps to the dwelling [of its owner];
(JK, Msb, K, TA;) contr. of وَحْشِىٌّ; (TA;) as also ↓ أَهِلٌ . (K.) You say حُمُرٌ أَهْلِيَّةٌ [Domestic asses]: (JK, TA:) occurring in a trad., in which their flesh is forbidden to be eaten. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
